tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Fuzzy keyword search over the candle catalog. Matches product names, descriptions and EAN barcodes; multiple words must all match.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one product: description, price (EUR, incl. VAT), EAN, live stock, categories, page URL and all image URLs.

tools.name: browse_catalog
tools.description: The catalog navigation tree: scents, product types and collections with their ids, for use with list_products.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List catalog products, optionally filtered by exactly one facet id from browse_catalog. Without a filter, returns the whole visible catalog.
